subScenes.name: 生日问候
subScenes.description: 朋友见面时送上生日祝福，使用基本问候语。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友或同事向你表达生日祝福，你需要自然回应

followUps.text: Thanks so much! You really made my day.
followUps.text_cn: 太感谢了！你让我的一天特别开心。

followUps.text: Hey, thanks! Let’s grab a drink later if you’re free.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！如果你有空，待会儿一起喝一杯吧。

followUps.text: Aw, thanks! I’m just gonna chill at home today.
followUps.text_cn: 哎呀，谢谢！我今天就宅在家里放松一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应他人生日祝福，根据你当天的心情和计划选择不同回应方式，体现自然社交反应

qaPairs.triggerText: Hope you have an amazing birthday!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 希望你过一个超棒的生日！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事或朋友表达更具体的生日祝愿，你需要回应

followUps.text: That means a lot—I’m planning a small dinner with close friends.
followUps.text_cn: 这太暖心了！我打算和几个密友吃顿小饭。

followUps.text: I appreciate that! I’m actually traveling tomorrow, so this is a nice start.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你！我明天就要出发旅行了，这真是个美好的开端。

followUps.text: Thanks! I didn’t expect anyone to remember—it’s just another day for me.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我没指望有人记得，对我来说就是普通的一天。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当祝福语更具体时，回应可结合个人计划或情绪，展现真实社交中的多样性

qaPairs.triggerText: Happy birthday! How are you celebrating?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 生日快乐！你打算怎么庆祝？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方不仅祝福，还主动询问庆祝计划，需回应

followUps.text: Just a cake at work and maybe a movie tonight—nothing fancy!
followUps.text_cn: 就公司吃个蛋糕，晚上可能看个电影——没那么隆重！

followUps.text: Actually, I’m having a surprise party—do you want to come?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我有个惊喜派对——你要来吗？

followUps.text: I’m not really in the mood to celebrate this year… but thanks for asking.
followUps.text_cn: 今年我其实没什么心情庆祝……不过还是谢谢你问起。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方询问庆祝方式时，回应可体现开放、邀请或情绪状态，是社交中高频率且自然的互动环节

subScenes.name: 询问计划
subScenes.description: 询问对方生日有什么安排，表达关心。

qaPairs.triggerText: What are you doing for your birthday?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友询问生日计划，社交场景中的典型问候

followUps.text: I'm having a small dinner with a few close friends.
followUps.text_cn: 我和几个好朋友吃顿小饭。

followUps.text: Actually, I'm just going to relax at home—I'm pretty tired this month.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我就想在家休息，这个月太累了。

followUps.text: I haven't decided yet—maybe a trip if I can get time off.
followUps.text_cn: 我还没决定，如果能请假可能去旅行。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友间自然询问生日安排，回应需体现真实态度，避免过度正式

qaPairs.triggerText: Any big plans for your birthday?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事或熟人礼貌询问生日安排，常见于办公室社交

followUps.text: Yeah, we're throwing a little party at the office—hope you can make it!
followUps.text_cn: 有啊，我们办公室要办个小派对，希望你能来！

followUps.text: Nothing fancy—I just want to eat cake and call my mom.
followUps.text_cn: 没什么特别的，就想吃块蛋糕，给妈妈打个电话。

followUps.text: I was thinking of going hiking—anyone want to join?
followUps.text_cn: 我本来想爬山，有人想一起来吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应需根据关系亲疏调整语气，职场中可适度热情，但避免过度夸张

qaPairs.triggerText: So, what’s the plan for your big day?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 那你生日那天有什么安排？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 亲密朋友用轻松语气追问生日计划，语气带点调侃或期待

followUps.text: Surprise party planned—don’t tell anyone!
followUps.text_cn: 他们给我准备了惊喜派对——别告诉别人！

followUps.text: I’m skipping it this year—I’ve got a big project deadline.
followUps.text_cn: 今年我打算跳过，有个大项目截止日。

followUps.text: I’m flying to visit my sister—she’s been asking me to come for ages!
followUps.text_cn: 我要飞去探望我妹妹，她早就盼着我去了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 语气可更随意，甚至带点幽默，适合亲密关系；注意区分‘我被惊喜’和‘我主动安排’两种情境

subScenes.name: 赠送礼物
subScenes.description: 送出礼物并附上礼貌的祝福语句。

qaPairs.triggerText: This is for you — happy birthday!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友赠送生日礼物时的典型开场

followUps.text: Oh my gosh, you didn’t have to get me anything! This is so thoughtful!
followUps.text_cn: 天啊，你不用买礼物的！这太贴心了！

followUps.text: Wait, is this the book I mentioned last week? You remembered?!
followUps.text_cn: 等等，这是上周我提过的那本书？你记住了？！

followUps.text: Haha, you got me a socks set? I needed these! Perfect!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，你给我买了袜子？我正缺这个呢！太棒了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友间赠送礼物时的自然回应，体现情感真实性和个性化反应

qaPairs.triggerText: I picked this out thinking of you — hope you like it!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我挑这个的时候就想到了你——希望你喜欢！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事或熟人赠送礼物时的温和表达

followUps.text: I love it! This is exactly my style — thank you so much!
followUps.text_cn: 我太喜欢了！这完全是我的风格——太谢谢你了！

followUps.text: It’s beautiful, but you really shouldn’t have spent money on me...
followUps.text_cn: 真漂亮，但你真的不用为我花这个钱的……

followUps.text: Wow, this is so cool! Can I open it now?
followUps.text_cn: 哇，这太酷了！我现在可以打开吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场或半正式社交关系中，回应礼物时平衡礼貌与真诚

qaPairs.triggerText: Happy birthday! I got you something small — open it!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 生日快乐！我给你带了点小礼物——打开看看！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 轻松随意的生日礼物赠送场景

followUps.text: You’re the best! This is the perfect gift — I’ve been wanting this forever!
followUps.text_cn: 你太棒了！这礼物太完美了——我早就想要这个了！

followUps.text: Aww, you remembered my favorite color? That’s so sweet!
followUps.text_cn: 啊，你还记得我最喜欢的颜色？太暖心了！

followUps.text: Haha, another candle? You know I have like 20 already!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，又一个蜡烛？你知道我已经快有二十个了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于亲密朋友或熟人之间轻松幽默的礼物交换，体现自然口语节奏

subScenes.name: 表达感谢
subScenes.description: 收礼者回应祝福，表达感激之情。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thanks so much for the birthday wishes!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友或同事向你表达感谢，因为你送了生日祝福

followUps.text: You're so welcome! I hope you had an amazing day!
followUps.text_cn: 不客气！希望你度过了超棒的一天！

followUps.text: Haha, it was nothing! But next time, you're treating me to cake!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，小事一桩！不过下次你得请我吃蛋糕！

followUps.text: Of course! I always love celebrating with you.
followUps.text_cn: 当然啦！我总是很喜欢和你一起庆祝。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友或同事之间收到感谢时的自然回应，避免机械式'You're welcome'，体现情感温度

qaPairs.triggerText: I really appreciated your card and gift!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我真的很感谢你的贺卡和礼物！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事或朋友具体提到你送的卡片和礼物，表达感谢

followUps.text: I'm so glad you liked it! I picked it because I knew you'd love it.
followUps.text_cn: 太开心你喜欢！我选它是因为我知道你会爱上它。

followUps.text: No need to thank me—just promise you'll let me do it again next year!
followUps.text_cn: 不用谢我——只答应我明年还能再给你送一次！

followUps.text: Aw, thanks for saying that—it made my day too!
followUps.text_cn: 哎呀，谢谢你这么说——这让我也特别开心！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适合在收到具体感谢时，用个性化回应增强社交亲密度，避免敷衍

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方因你记得生日而特别表达感激，可能暗示平时被忽略

followUps.text: Of course I remembered—you're one of my favorite people!
followUps.text_cn: 我当然记得啊，你是我最喜欢的人之一！

followUps.text: Honestly? I almost forgot—but then I panicked and sent something last minute!
followUps.text_cn: 说实话？我差点忘了，但最后关头慌了才赶紧送的！

followUps.text: It's the least I could do—you've been so kind to me this year.
followUps.text_cn: 这是我该做的，你今年对我一直这么好。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于对方强调‘记得生日’这一行为本身，回应需体现真诚、幽默或互惠，避免冷淡

subScenes.name: 告别祝福
subScenes.description: 结束对话时再次祝愿生日快乐。

qaPairs.triggerText: Happy birthday! Have a great night!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 生日快乐！今晚玩得开心！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 生日派对结束时，朋友送上告别祝福

followUps.text: Thanks so much! You made my day!
followUps.text_cn: 太感谢了！你让我的生日特别棒！

followUps.text: I really appreciate it! Hope you have an awesome year too!
followUps.text_cn: 真的很感激！也希望你今年一切顺利！

followUps.text: Haha, thanks! Let’s do this again next year!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，谢谢！咱们明年再搞一次！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友或同事在生日派对尾声表达祝福时的自然回应，语气应温暖、真诚或轻松，避免过于正式。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hope you have an amazing year ahead!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在生日蛋糕前送上未来祝福

followUps.text: That means a lot—I’m really lucky to have friends like you.
followUps.text_cn: 这太暖心了，能有你们这样的朋友真幸运。

followUps.text: Thanks! I’m hoping to travel more this year.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我今年希望能多出去旅行。

followUps.text: Aww, thanks! I’ll need all the luck I can get!
followUps.text_cn: 哎呀，谢谢！我可得把好运都攒着了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适合职场或半正式社交场合，回应时可结合个人生活目标，增强对话真实感。

qaPairs.triggerText: Happy birthday! Don’t work too hard this year!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 生日快乐！今年别太拼了！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事用轻松调侃语气送上生日祝福

followUps.text: Haha, I’ll try—but no promises!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，我会努力的——但不敢打包票！

followUps.text: You’re right—I’m actually planning to take more time off.
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，我其实正计划多休息呢。

followUps.text: Too late—I already booked three overtime shifts!
followUps.text_cn: 晚了，我已经排了三个加班班了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于关系较熟的同事间，语气可带调侃，体现轻松社交氛围，避免严肃回应。
